collection_arrays.input: 1..8 finite ordered scalar Image frames from a local Collection or ImageSequence,1..8 same-name/same-order unique bands,<=64 total output cells
collection_arrays.parameters: Required collection; axis numeric integer0 including integral float0.0/-0.0, bool rejected; dropMasked strictly Boolean false (default), true rejected because dynamic shapes are unsupported
collection_arrays.output: Each band is a real (frames,) RasterArrayImage; multiple bands use typed RasterArrayBands. Exact cells/order and duplicate observations are retained. Each band independently conjoins that band validity across every frame. Leftover scene properties are not inherited; finite union footprint/source policy retained
collection_arrays.shared_helper: Existing ordered-frame and scalar-schema validation extracted in raster_regression_frames.py without changing regression labels/behavior

array_reshape.input: Single fixed-shape RasterArrayImage; lengths is a rank1 RasterArrayImage of pure constant integer cells with mask provably const(True), not a scalar-band list
array_reshape.parameters: Required image,lengths,dimensions; output1..8 dimensions, each1..64,<=64 cells, at most one -1 inferred by exact division; input cell count must be preserved
array_reshape.output: Same row-major Pixel tuple, input mask, name and Image metadata; no arithmetic, copying samples or implicit dtype conversion. Rank0 input can reshape to[1]; dimensions0 explicitly rejects

trigonometry.input: Required finite static int/float radians, integers restricted to magnitude<=2^53, bool and other types rejected; unknown parameters rejected
trigonometry.algorithm: Real Float64 math.sin/math.cos after shared-work precharge; host libm argument reduction and large-angle last bits are local policies, not Google equivalence
